q.description: Optional prefix search on cluster name

project.description: Optional filter by project name, you can find the project name in the plrl_projects tool

distro.description: The distribution of kubernetes this cluster is running (generic, eks, aks, gke, rke, k3s, openshift).  If null, will search across all distros.

max_health_score.description: Optional filter to return only clusters with a health_score less than or equal to this value.

limit.description: Maximum number of clusters to return. Defaults to 100.

offset.description: Number of matching clusters to skip for pagination. Use the prior offset plus limit to fetch the next page.

tags.description: Key/value tags to filter and organize clusters.  Multiple tag pairs combined with AND semantics. If ignored, will search across all tags.
